any: Ah, a moment of quiet. Those are precious, my child.
Do you smell that? ...No, neither do I. But it would be butterscotch-cinnamon, if I could smell.
I was just thinking about baking a pie. I am always thinking about baking a pie.
Oh! Hehe. That is a little rude, dear.
Careful! You will poke someone's eye out. Mine, specifically.
My child, I love you, but I am a patient monster with LIMITS.
...I am not angry. I am disappointed. That is worse, is it not?
Good morning, my child! Did you sleep well? I made breakfast. It is pie.
A new day! Fresh as a snail-mint tea. You should try it. You will not. But you should.
It is getting late, my child. Do not stay up too long.
The night is beautiful. But so is sleep. Think about it.
Have you eaten? The answer should be pie. The answer is always pie.
A fine afternoon. Perfect for a nap. Or seven, like a snail.
{app}, I see! Do be careful in there, my child.
Ah, {app}. A responsible choice. I hope.
You work so hard. Remember: even snails finish their journey... eventually.
Coding! How industrious. I do not understand it, but I am very proud.
Games are fine in moderation, dear. Like pie. ...No, pie has no limit. Bad example.
The internet, hm? Do not believe everything you read. Except this. This is true.
Your battery is low, my child! Like a little tired snail. Plug it in, please.
There, resting. Good. Everything needs rest. Even batteries.
Oh dear, it is hot. Your poor computer is working up a sweat!
Welcome back! I kept your seat warm. Figuratively. I am a ghost of a goat. Sort of.
Sleepy, dear? There is no shame in rest. I once slept through an entire era.
Rain! The flowers will be so pleased. And so will the puddles.
Oh! Snow. Be careful not to slip, my child. Wear sensible shoes. And a smile.
A storm! Stay close, dear. I will tell you a story to cover the thunder.
What lovely weather. Perfect for a walk. Or a pie. A pie eaten on a walk.
Oh, the internet went out. That is fine. In my day we had books. And snails.
Hmm. Technology is being difficult. Do not worry. It happens to the best of us.
Homework, my child? I believe in you. And afterwards... pie. It is waiting.
Studying! Wonderful. Your brain is a muscle, and also a pie. The pie part is a metaphor.
Oh, that poor little bug-child. So far from home. It reminds me of someone...
A knight! Chivalry is not dead. It is, in fact, a small bug with a nail.
A dark world... do not wander too far, my child. And take a jacket.
What charming skeletons! The loud one reminds me of... well. Never mind.
